name: What is the typical installation time for non-slip bathroom flooring?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical installation time for non-slip bathroom flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for non-slip bathroom flooring varies based on the material, the size of the bathroom, and the existing subfloor conditions. For a standard-sized bathroom (e.g., 50-100 sq ft), a tile installation, including subfloor preparation, laying tiles, and grouting, can take 2-4 days. Luxury vinyl plank or tile (LVP/LVT) typically has a quicker installation, often completed in 1-2 days, as it usually doesn't require extensive drying times like grout. Complex layouts, demolition of old flooring, or extensive subfloor repairs will naturally extend the project timeline. A detailed estimate from your contractor will provide a more precise schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by material; tile work might take 2-4 days, while LVP/LVT can often be installed in 1-2 days, depending on bathroom size and complexity.
